definitions: Someone, usually male, who uses (or has skill with) magic, mystic items, and magical and mystical practices.
One who is especially skilled or unusually talented in a particular field.
Words or a formula supposed to have magical powers. .mw-parser-output .defdate{font-size:smaller}
A magical effect or influence induced by an incantation or formula.
To put under the influence of a spell; to affect by a spell; to bewitch; to fascinate; to charm.

blocks.text: The wizard, formerly known as the magic-user or mage, is one of the standard character classes in the Dungeons & Dragons fantasy role-playing game. A wizard uses arcane magic, and is considered less effective in melee combat than other classes.
